basis: Canonical employer-primary-business definitions read 2026-11-05; changed definitions require interpretation, never automatic exclusion.

rules.match: exclude before intake only when the employer's core business is pharmaceutical drug development/manufacturing/commercial pharmaceutical production.

exclude before intake only when the employer's core business is manufacturing/commercializing medical devices, medical equipment, surgical/diagnostic devices, or comparable regulated healthcare hardware.
exclude before intake only when the employer's core business is manufacturing, processing, packaging, or commercially producing food or beverage products.
exclude before intake only when the employer's core business is restaurant, fast-food, quick-service, catering, food-service, or comparable consumer meal-service operations.
